resources.string: GeoStamp Camera needs GPS location services enabled to stamp accurate coordinates and addresses onto your photos.
GeoStamp Camera burns real-time GPS coordinates, address, compass direction, altitude, and map thumbnail directly onto your photos.\n\nTo do this, we need Camera and Location permissions.
Camera permission is required to preview and capture photos.
Precise location permission is required to detect GPS coordinates, altitude, and look up address stamps.
To prevent aggressive battery management from delaying GPS fixes, consider setting GeoStamp Camera battery usage to \'Unrestricted\' in App info.

Zero Ads. Zero Analytics. Zero Trackers.

All photos, EXIF data, and GPS locations remain strictly on your device. The app never sends your personal data to any external server.

Only anonymous requests are made to OpenStreetMap tile servers to render map thumbnails and to Open-Meteo for weather updates.
